integrity: An elementary analytic proof is supplied, including rational exchange rigidity. Standalone exact-rational checks and numerical LP corroboration passed; computation is not a substitute for the infinite proof. No external independent audit.
scientific_limitations: Only complete allocations of n>=2 agents and m>=1 identical unit-cost indivisible chores with strictly positive normalized entitlements; no generalization to heterogeneous costs, eligibility constraints or strategyproof lotteries. Novelty is assessed against inspected sources, not proved by search.
title: Arithmetic rigidity of best-of-both-worlds fairness for identical chores
